en.headline: Hang Seng falls to near 19-month low as AI sell-off weighs on tech shares
en.dek: The index dropped as much as 1.8 per cent in morning trade on Monday, with the tech gauge down more than 1 per cent amid continued pressure from US AI stock declines.
body: Hong Kong stocks slid on Monday, with the Hang Seng Index falling as much as 1.8 per cent and briefly dipping below 22,000 before recovering some ground by midday.

The benchmark closed the morning session down 0.64 per cent, or about 143 points, near 22,267, according to market reports. It extended Friday’s decline that had left the index at its lowest close since April 2025.

Technology shares were hit hardest. The Hang Seng Tech Index fell as much as 3 per cent intraday and ended the morning down about 1 per cent. Analysts attributed the pressure to a continued sell-off in US artificial intelligence stocks spilling over into Asia.
The market remained open in the afternoon, with trading volumes moderate as investors assessed the broader regional impact.

zh.headline: 恒指一度跌穿22000點 科技股受AI拋售拖累
zh.dek: 周一早市恒生指數最多跌1.8%，科技指數跌逾1%，延續美股人工智能股跌勢影響。
body: 港股周一走低，恒生指數早市最多下跌1.8%，一度跌穿22000點後部分收復失地。
據市場報告，大市半日收市跌0.64%，約143點，報約22267點。指數延續上周五的跌勢，當時收市已創自2025年4月以來低位。
科技股受壓最重。恒生科技指數早市最多跌3%，半日跌約1%。分析指，美國人工智能相關股票持續拋售，壓力外溢至亞洲市場。
下午市況仍在進行，成交量中等，投資者評估地區影響。
